bordered.zh-CN: 是否展示边框，仅在非全屏模式下有效，默认不展示。
bordered.en-US: Whether to show a border. Only takes effect in non-full mode, and no border is shown by default.

children.zh-CN: 自定义内容，渲染在横幅底部的额外区域。
children.en-US: Custom content rendered in the extra area below the banner.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 替换关闭按钮内的图标；传 `null` 时不显示关闭按钮，未设置时显示默认关闭图标。
closeIcon.en-US: Replaces the icon in the close button. Pass `null` to hide the close button; the default close icon is shown when unset.

fullMode.zh-CN: 是否为全屏模式；设为 false 时使用非全屏样式。
fullMode.en-US: Whether the banner is in full mode. Set it to false for the non-full style.

icon.zh-CN: 替换 `type` 对应的图标；传 `null` 时不显示图标，未设置时显示该类型的默认图标。
icon.en-US: Replaces the icon of `type`. Pass `null` to hide the icon; the icon of `type` is shown when unset.

onClose.zh-CN: 点击关闭按钮时调用，参数为按钮的原生 click 事件；回调返回后横幅隐藏。
onClose.en-US: Called when the close button is clicked, with its native click event. The banner hides after the callback returns.
